At the Sydney Children's Hospitals Network, every role helps children and young people live their healthiest lives.

As the largest paediatric health service in Australia, we care for thousands of children each year, in hospital and at home. Our people are united by compassion, collaboration and excellence in care.

Join a team where your passion for paediatric care truly makes a difference. Sydney Children's Hospital, Randwick - one of Australia's leading specialist medical centres for children - has entered an exciting new chapter with the opening of the Bilima Building in November 2025. This state-of-the-art redevelopment will enhance our ability to deliver world-class care to seriously ill and injured children from across NSW and beyond. 

As part of the Sydney Children's Hospitals Network, our hospital provides a comprehensive range of paediatric and adolescent medical and surgical services, treating children with a variety of complex conditions. Located in Sydney's eastern suburbs and co-located with Prince of Wales Hospital and the Royal Hospital for Women, our campus offers easy access to beaches, amenities, and public transport. 

At Sydney Children's Hospital, Randwick, we put children first - always. You'll be part of a warm, supportive environment dedicated to improving the lives of children and their families.

What you'll be doing
 

The Clinical Nurse Educator (CNE) will be responsible for the delivery and evaluation of clinical nursing education. The CNE will work in collaboration with the Nursing Unit Manager (NUM) and Nurse Educator (NE) and wider hospital team to develop and implement clinical education relevant to specialities and basic nursing competencies. 

The CNE will work collaboratively to support clinical education to others outside the ward- unit when required. 

Additional Benefits (where applicable): Flexible work opportunities, Salary packaging and meal entertainment benefits, accrued days off (ADOs), fitness passport, employee assistance program (EAP)

Click 'Apply Online' and submit your application including:

A resume (maximum 5 pages) outlining your experience

Current Authority to Practice as a Registered Nurse with the Australian Health Practitioner Regulation Agency (AHPRA).

Relevant clinical or education post registration qualifications or such education and clinical experience deemed appropriate by the employer

Demonstrated effective clinical teaching skills

Demonstrated commitment to clinical and professional development

Demonstrated advanced written, verbal and interpersonal skills

Knowledge and understanding of NSQHS Standards relating to education

Knowledge of adult learning principles

 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 

 

Child Safe Standards:
SCHN is committed to maintaining a child-safe environment that respects and upholds the rights of children and young people, in line with NSW Health's commitment to the Child Safe Standards. We aim to ensure that children and young people feel safe, supported, and included in their care. All current and prospective staff are expected to prioritise the safety, welfare, and well-being of children and young people, actively working to protect them from harm and abuse.

Additional Information: 

SCHN is an Equal Opportunity Employer that values diversity, recognising that a diverse workforce strengthens our culture and enhances the care we provide to children, young people and their families.

Permanent NSW Health roles require Australian citizenship or permanent residency. Temporary visa holders may be considered where no suitable Australian citizen or permanent resident is identified.

NSW Health vaccination and screening requirements must be met prior to commencement. 

This position requires a Working with Children Check (WWCC) issued by the Office of the Children's Guardian.

Where required, overseas qualifications must be formally assessed by the Department of Education or relevant authority for recognition in Australia.

An Eligibility List may be created for future permanent and temporary part time vacancies.

Job title: Practice Nurse	Reports to: Head Nurse 
                        Chief Executive Officer
Purpose of position
To ensure smooth and efficient functioning of the practice and provide an exceptional standard of care to our patients.

Responsibilities 

Clinical
•	Perform clinical duties within required level of clinical competency, according to best available evidence.  Explain procedures to patients, providing them with support and reassurance.  Duties include triage, immunisations and other injections; wound management, chronic disease management, ECG’s and collection of pathology samples.  Assist doctors with clinical procedures.  Maintain clinical documentation.
•	Oversee cold chain process, awareness, responsibilities and documentation of cold chain process.
•	Monitor infection control standards and implement changes / educate.

Patient Services
•	Assist with triage, data management, diagnostic services, networking with other providers, planning & management of patient care and patient advocacy.  Telephone patients with test results as directed by medical staff.  

Improvement of Patient Health Outcomes
•	Conduct preventative/screening procedures; assist with patient education and community health promotion activities.  Co-ordinate patient recall and outreach programs and GP management plans and team care arrangement.  

Equipment and Supplies
•	Maintain stocks of clinical supplies, including correct storage (such as refrigeration), removal of out-of-date stock and ordering supplies.  Provide input in purchasing relevant clinical equipment and supplies.
•	Assist with stock ordering bi – monthly
•	Assist with monthly vaccine order
•	Complete daily job allocation sheet
•	Check emergency trolley daily
•	Check O2 therapy as per job description
•	Monitor cold chain process twice daily

Compliance
•	Maintain awareness of current and new legislation to ensure business is complying with all statutory and regulatory obligations including infection control, sterilisation, hazardous materials & safe handling/disposal of medical waste, records management, OHS, and accreditation.  Ensure relevant personnel are kept informed and changes are made to systems and procedures as required.  

Professional
•	Act within the practice and nursing code of ethics & appropriate level of clinical competence at all times.  Maintain awareness of current evidence and research on clinical practices and inform/educate other practice staff. Change systems and procedures to ensure compliance with best available evidence as applicable.  

OHS
•	Consistently be aware of OHS requirements and comply with them.

General
Delegation of tasks to other medical and non-medical staff. 
Assist with other practice duties as required.  

Expected behaviours and personal attributes 
•	Demonstrate a knowledge of and compliance with all relevant legislation and common law obligations affecting nursing.

•	Demonstrate knowledge of policies and procedural guidelines that have legal implications, for example, ensure documentation conforms to legal requirements.

•	Excellent interpersonal and communication skills across all ages and social groups.
•	Be always well presented, friendly, courteous and obliging.  Represent the practice in a confident and positive manner at all times. 
•	Undertake all duties in a diligent manner, with honesty and integrity, 
•	Maintain absolute confidentiality regarding patient and practice information.
•	Have a vigilant attitude to accuracy, being prepared to double check as necessary.
•	Ability to work cooperatively and independently. & ability to prioritise and organise, with attention to detail.
•	Demonstrated commitment to ongoing professional development
•	This position requires physical ability to occasionally lift and/or move patients.
•	Possession of current driver’s licence (include only if essential to perform job, such as home visits)

Education, Qualifications and Experience  
Essential:
•	Appropriate tertiary qualification & registration certificate. 
•	Professional indemnity cover.
•	Minimum of one year of nursing experience, preferably in a community-based role.
•	Demonstrated understanding of the needs of general practice and interest in community-based nursing including patient education and health promotion.

Desirable:

About Us
Golden Goose Australia Pty Ltd is a premium fashion retailer specialising in luxury sneakers, clothing, footwear, bags and accessories. We pride ourselves on delivering high-quality products and exceptional customer service.

About the Role
We are seeking an experienced and dynamic Retail Store Manager to lead our store operations, drive sales growth and deliver a world-class customer experience. The successful candidate will be responsible for achieving commercial objectives, managing and developing the store team, maintaining brand and visual merchandising standards, and ensuring the efficient operation of the store.
This role requires a reliable, empowering and supportive leader with strong commercial awareness, excellent communication skills and proven experience managing a premium retail environment.

Key Responsibilities
Sales and Customer Experience
* Manage store sales targets and monitor performance through relevant key performance indicators.
* Develop and implement action plans in consultation with the Area Manager to improve sales performance.
* Lead and motivate the team to achieve commercial targets while maintaining high customer service standards.
* Ensure employees consistently follow the company’s selling processes, including up-selling, cross-selling and promoting available services.
* Provide customers with accurate information regarding products, pricing, services and expected timeframes.
* Build strong customer relationships through personalised service and regular follow-up.
* Monitor customer feedback and implement initiatives to improve customer satisfaction.
* Build relationships with the local community and act as a brand ambassador to attract new customers and retain existing clients.
* Manage customer database development, segmentation and profiling.
* Drive in-store and omnichannel sales by effectively using available systems, tools and technology.

Business and Network Development
* Support the Area Manager in developing long-term market growth strategies.
* Establish and maintain commercial relationships and partnerships within the local market.
* Monitor relevant retail and industry trends.
* Identify and recommend sales opportunities and business development initiatives.

Brand and Product Management
* Represent and promote the company’s brand values, heritage and vision.

* Ensure the team remains informed and trained on all product collections and categories.
Team Leadership and Human Resources
* Recruit, manage, develop, motivate and empower store employees.

* Conduct daily and weekly store briefings to communicate objectives, priorities and sales strategies.
* Support new employees throughout the onboarding process.
* Ensure employees comply with company grooming and uniform standards.
* Work closely with the Area Manager and Human Resources team to recruit suitable employees.
* Manage employee performance and implement appropriate improvement measures where required.
* Prepare staff rosters and ensure appropriate staffing levels are maintained.

Store Operations and Compliance
* Supervise and coordinate all store activities to ensure efficient daily operations.
* Ensure compliance with the company’s standard operating procedures.
* Oversee stock and back-of-house operations, including receiving and transferring stock, stocktaking, stock control, storage, reporting and store administration.

Experience in premium, luxury or fashion retail will be highly regarded.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Our elite sales team is made up of passionate, dedicated professionals, delivering the most advanced medical technologies to patients in need. By collaborating extensively with leading healthcare professionals you’ll see first-hand the impact you have on individual lives - one patient at a time. 

The position of Clinical Specialist, Electrophysiology (EP), provides field/remote clinical, technical & educational support in EP to assigned accounts across ANZ. The primary focus is to support new therapy introduction of Pulsed Field Ablation through our recent launch of the FARAPULSE™ system, demonstrating clinical expertise to influence superior outcomes. Frequent travel will be required as part of the role. 

The Clinical Specialist – Electrophysiology role is based in Queensland and reports to the Field Clinical Specialist Manager.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

•	Utilising your technical knowledge of:
o	The field of electrophysiology (including propagation of electrical circuits within cardiac tissue and the pathophysiology of electrical rhythm disorders), biophysics of radiofrequency, cryo-thermal ablation, 2D and 3D electroanatomical mapping principles to provide:
?	Clinical support including basic trouble-shooting, and clinical guidance to diagnose and treat cardiac arrhythmias
?	Provide the measurement of electrical circuits within the heart and perform stimulation protocols as per physician requests to measure the electrical conductivity of the heart to aid in the diagnosis of cardiac arrhythmias
?	Develop a deep technical understanding of, and provide the technical training of company products to Cardiac Electrophysiologists, Cardiac Physiologists and Nurses
•	Travelling as required to meet customer demand for the services described above.
•	Attending cases face to face (or remotely) with customers, operating Boston Scientific products where appropriate, and providing detailed training / advice to physicians on clinical attributes / techniques associated with Boston Scientific electrophysiology products including:
o	Providing clinical support for: FARAPULSE™, OPAL™, RHYTHMIA™, LAB SYSTEM PRO™, MAESTRO 4000™, METRIQ™, plus support for the full range of Boston Scientific EP Catheters
•	Developing deep understanding on the workflows and specificities of each hospital & business relationships with hospital personnel (e.g., through informal conversation, meetings, participation in conferences) to make new contacts in other departments within hospital and all stakeholders to ensure that products are trained and utilised in accordance with the Directions for Use.
•	Ensuring timely collection, reporting of all required medical documentation pertaining to our procedural device operation.
•	Responding to complex customer needs and complaints regarding products and service by developing creative and feasible solutions or working with other related personnel (e.g., sales, clinical, research, marketing, technical support) to develop optimal solutions.
•	Recording customer information and activities in company’s CRM system: use the system as an alignment tool with other commercial roles.
•	Completion of relevant administration including reporting, stock validations and inventory management
•	Attending meetings, conferences and exhibitions as required to promote Boston Scientific products and services.
•	Being available to support the broader ANZ Rhythm Management business on an as-needs basis

KEY COMPETENCIES REQUIRED FOR SUCCESS 

Product/Technical Knowledge
•	Successfully completes all relevant Electrophysiology training. 
•	Develop in depth knowledge of Electrophysiology procedure, products and treatment applications.
•	Proactively keeps up to date with technical knowledge in Electrophysiology.

Relationship Building 
•	Builds and maintains effective networks that add value in achieving work related goals.
•	Skilled in building rapport with a wide variety of individuals.
•	Understands the balance between taking time to build rapport and achieving objectives set.
•	Works effectively and collaboratively within the team environment.

Adaptability 

•	Responds resourcefully, flexibly, and positively when faced with new challenges and demands. 
•	Moves forward productively and optimistically under conditions of change or uncertainty.

Organisation & Reporting
•	Maintains well organised materials, files, system and reports.
•	Plans and prioritises territory activity.
•	Makes sure all parts of a job are completed in full, within deadlines, including follow-up plans and documentation.

Results Focused
•	Demonstrates a growth mindset.
•	Measures own performance and seeks feedback for self-development
•	Demonstrates resilience and has a strong sense of urgency
•	Recognises and acts on opportunities.
•	Maintains a flexible approach to meet goals

YOUR EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS

•	Clinical case experience within Electrophysiology / Cardiac Rhythm Management is highly regarded
•	Understanding of conventional Electrophysiology (EP), including EP signal interpretation, 3D Mapping, Cryoablation and Troubleshooting experience is highly regarded
•	Knowledge of Cardiac Electrophysiology principles, including Radiofrequency, Cryoablation, and Pulsed Field Ablation (PFA)
•	Tertiary qualifications in biomedical engineering, science or a related field

•	Demonstrated expertise in building and maintaining strong relationships.

## Sales and Marketing Manager
## Position Overview
We are looking for a dynamic and results-driven Sales and Marketing Manager to lead and execute strategic commercial initiatives across our organisation. This role is central to driving revenue growth, brand positioning, and market expansion through the effective management of both sales operations and marketing programmes. The ideal candidate is a confident leader with a proven track record of delivering measurable outcomes in a fast-paced, customer-focused environment. You will bring a strategic mindset, strong analytical capability, and the ability to inspire and manage cross-functional teams.
## Key Responsibilities
- Formulate, implement, and continuously refine integrated sales and marketing strategies, ensuring alignment with broader organisational goals and growth targets
- Develop and oversee advertising, public relations, and promotional campaigns, working collaboratively with internal stakeholders and external agencies to maximise brand impact
- Establish and manage sales territories, customer service standards, and product mix to optimise market coverage and revenue performance
- Direct and coordinate the activities of sales personnel, agents, and distributors to ensure consistent execution of sales methods and commercial objectives
- Set pricing structures, credit arrangements, and discount frameworks in line with market conditions and company profitability targets
- Oversee merchandising methods and distribution policy, ensuring product availability and visibility across all relevant channels
- Monitor and analyse market trends, competitor activity, and customer insights to inform strategic decision-making and identify new business opportunities
- Develop and manage the sales and marketing budget, tracking expenditure and return on investment to ensure efficient allocation of resources
- Lead the generation and nurturing of leads across digital and traditional channels, converting pipeline opportunities into long-term client relationships
- Produce regular performance reports and present findings to senior leadership, providing data-driven recommendations for continuous improvement
- Build and maintain strong relationships with key clients, partners, and industry stakeholders to support retention and business development
- Recruit, mentor, and develop team members, fostering a high-performance culture focused on accountability, collaboration, and professional growth
## Required Qualifications & Skills
- Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Commerce, or a related discipline
- Minimum of 5 years' experience in a sales and/or marketing management role, with demonstrated success in meeting or exceeding commercial targets
- Strong understanding of both B2B and B2C sales environments, including pipeline management and customer lifecycle strategies
- Proven experience developing and executing multi-channel marketing campaigns, including digital, content, and traditional media
- Proficiency in CRM platforms and marketing automation tools, with the ability to leverage data for strategic insight
- Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with experience in budgeting, forecasting, and performance reporting
- Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to present to senior stakeholders and external partners
- Demonstrated leadership capability, with experience managing, coaching, and developing sales and marketing teams
- High level of commercial acumen and a customer-centric approach to business development
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities and deliver results within deadlines
## Preferred Qualifications
- Postgraduate qualification such as a Master of Business Administration (MBA) or equivalent
- Professional accreditation with the Australian Marketing Institute (AMI) or a recognised industry body
- Experience working within a specific industry relevant to our business, such as retail, technology, professional services, or FMCG
- Familiarity with SEO, SEM, and performance marketing strategies, as well as experience managing digital advertising budgets
- Exposure to international or cross-regional markets, including an understanding of export or distribution networks
- Experience with sales enablement tools, marketing analytics platforms, or enterprise-level CRM systems such as Salesforce or HubSpot
## Why Join Us?
- Be part of a collaborative and forward-thinking organisation that genuinely values innovation, initiative, and professional development
- Access ongoing learning and career progression opportunities, including support for further study, industry certifications, and leadership programmes
- Enjoy a flexible working environment with hybrid arrangements available, supporting a healthy work-life balance
- Benefit from a competitive remuneration package, including performance-based incentives that reward your contribution to the business
- Join a team culture built on trust, inclusivity, and shared purpose, where your ideas are heard and your impact is recognised
## Job Details
- Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
- Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
- Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Super
